Goal
* Please format 9.81 as a {{constant}}.

* Please change "<<l2>" to "[[l2]]" in the formula of alpha2.

* The term "derivation function" is unclear/non-standard. (Should it be "derivative" instead of "derivation"?) Consider explicitly stating how f(S) and the instantaneous acceleration formulas are related.

* Consider stating that, after calculating S', S' becomes the current state for the next simulation step.

* Since the input angles and constraints are expressed in radians, consider replacing "180 degrees" with "π radians" in the flip definition.

* Please clarify whether crossing π or -π constitutes a flip, since the input angles are signed and may be negative.

Constraints
* Please merge the first two constraints and list the variables in the same order as they appear in the Input section.

Tags
* Please use existing tags only and remove the "RK4" tag.

Cases
* Validator 2: Please remove the trailing newline from the input.

* Currently phi1 is negative in 2 of the 4 tests, but not in any validators. Consider swapping one of those tests with its corresponding validator so that phi1 is negative in at least 1 validator.

* Please explain what scenario each case pair is intended to cover (here in the comment area).

Cover picture
* Please add a cover picture for the puzzle.

Thanks.

Updates done.

The scenarios each test some random case. For double pendulums that flip, there are no special scenarios that can be defined due to the chaos involved.

BTW: Is it possible to somehow also see the full cover image afterwards or just a thin stripe? If only the stripe is visible in the end, it would be great if the stripe could be seen during the clipping process. Otherwise it requires a lot of trial and error to find a good section of the image to use.

What you see here in the contribution view is exactly how the image will appear on the puzzle page once the contribution has been approved. The displayed height of the image also depends on the width of your browser window, so you can try resizing the window to see how the view changes.

There'll be quite a few changes, so I'd appreciate it if you could switch your contribution back to WIP first.

Goal
* "absolute angle": Should this be replaced with "signed angle"? phi1 and phi2 may be negative, whereas “absolute angle” could be interpreted as the absolute value of an angle.

* Please explicitly state how f(S) is related to the instantaneous acceleration formulas. It's currently unclear what "derivate function" refers to, or whether solvers are expected to derive it themselves.

* Consider changing "before any of the two pendulums flip" to "until either pendulum flips", which reads more naturally.

* It's not clear how the output time should be determined. For example, what if a flip occurs between 0.1234 seconds and 0.1235 seconds?

Output
* Please state the rounding rule instead of only giving an example. For example, change "used:" to "used, i.e. round up only if the next digit is 5 or greater. For example,".

Cases
* Validator 2: Please remove the trailing newline from the input.

* I understand that the exact motion of a double pendulum is chaotic, so there may not be neatly defined physical scenarios for individual cases. However, I think the cases can still be selected to test different aspects of a solution, for example, whether the relevant conditions are implemented correctly for certain edge cases. Some scenarios to consider:

  • configurations with different mass and length ratios;

  • positive versus negative initial angles (including both positive, both negative, phi1 positive and phi2 negative, phi1 negative and phi2 positive, both zero, phi1 zero and phi2 non-zero, phi1 non-zero and phi2 zero);

  • phi1 or phi2 close to a flip boundary;

  • an early flip versus a late flip;

  • cases where either the first or second pendulum flips first;

  • cases that cross +π versus cases that cross -π.

Therefore, please try to revise and/or add cases to include different kinds of scenarios and provide some progression from simpler cases to more complex ones, where possible.

(Multiple scenarios may appear in the same pair of cases.)

Thanks.

I made some changes to the existing test cases and updated the description as requested. Better now?

BTW: Why is it that saving a contribution often hangs, especially if validation errors occur? I can see that it says that a validation error has occurred in some test case, but that message just often stays for a long time (minutes), then either nothing happens or a 524 network error message is shown.

It's good to see the revised statement and cases, which are a clear improvement.

Goal
* Please add "downward" before "vertical".

* Please add "and" before "decreasing the angle".

* Consider rewriting the RK4 explanation paragraph as follows, since the variables don't "become" their derivatives:

#####
RK4 repeatedly calculates how the state changes over a small time interval. The rate of change of each angle is its angular velocity, and the rate of change of each angular velocity is its angular acceleration. Therefore, define

f([[phi1]], [[omega1]], [[phi2]], [[omega2]]) = ([[omega1]], [[alpha1]], [[omega2]], [[alpha2]]),

where [[alpha1]] and [[alpha2]] are calculated using the formulas above.
#####

* Please remove the extra "the" in "the the function".

* Consider rewriting the flip time explanation paragraph as follows, since a time step is an interval rather than a point in time:

#####
The double pendulum has to be simulated in discrete time steps of [[dt]] = {{0.0001}} seconds. The flip time is the time at the end of the simulation step in which a flip is detected for the first time. The flip time must be output with exactly 4 decimal places.
#####

Output
* Since the simulation time step of 0.0001 seconds is now mandatory rather than merely recommended, no rounding is required. Please change "rounded to" to "shown with exactly", and remove the second paragraph.

Constraints
* Two of the cases violate the final constraint. Please update it accordingly.

Cases
* Several validators are wrongly numbered. Please renumber them.

* Random test 2 (Test 6): Please remove the trailing newline from the input.

* Please swap the random cases so that, within each case pair, the signs of [[phi1]] and [[phi2]] in the test match those in the validator.

Thanks.
Thank you for the update. I don't have further comments at the moment.
